blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The House of Representatives will hold a necrological service on Monday for the late Quirino Governor Dakilo Carlo “Dax” Cua, who previously served as a lawmaker before becoming the top local executive of the landlocked province in the north. The service will be held from 9 a.m. to noon at the House plenary, according to the chamber’s statement. “Monday’s necrological service will bring Cua back to the chamber where he spent nine years as a legislator, as the House pays its final respects to a former colleague whose public career began in Quirino and grew into a voice […]...
